ops.oldText: for a period of sixty (60) days from the Effective Date, but in no event not later than December 31, 1999 (the "Warranty Period")
ops.newText: for a period of twelve (12) months from Corio's acceptance of the Software pursuant to Section 3.1 (the "Warranty Period")

input.comment: [Playbook] We extended the product warranty to twelve (12) months running from acceptance and removed the December 31, 1999 sunset, since a 60-day period measured from the Effective Date can expire before Acceptance Testing is even complete. Our playbook position is 12 months for software (90 days from acceptance would be our fallback).
input.summary: Extend software/service warranty period to 12 months from acceptance and delete the fixed 1999 expiry date.
